app_tagline: Extract tables from PDFs into Excel/CSV. No more manual retyping.
about_description: Automatically detects tables in PDF files and exports them as Excel (.xlsx) or CSV. Automates the tedious task of manually retyping data from invoices, reports, and other PDF documents.
pain_point_description: 52% of AP (Accounts Payable) teams spend 10+ hours per week on invoice processing, with 37% citing manual data entry as their #1 challenge. This app eliminates PDF-to-Excel retyping.
no_tables: No tables detected. Try a different PDF or extraction method.
desktop_recommended: This app is optimized for desktop use
